text: dsh-awesome-agent-preset 是面向 DSH Web 的精简日常编码 Agent 预设，通过声明式配置组合文件读写与搜索、Bash、后台任务、Skills 和按需上下文压缩，并关闭 PowerShell 沙箱及多种编排功能。它保留文件编辑、目录检索、长任务管理和提问等工具，适合希望使用直接编码工作流的 DSH 用户；安装后在预设列表选择 awesome-agent。配置启用 Bash 沙箱并设定命令超时，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-awesome-agent-preset is a lean coding preset for DSH Web. It combines filesystem tools, search, Bash, background jobs, skills and manual compaction. Install it and select awesome-agent for a direct coding workflow. It enables the Bash sandbox and needs no extra key or external service.
想给 DSH 配一个专注日常写代码的精简 Agent。
让 DSH 的编码助手能读写文件并快速搜索项目目录。
我希望命令行任务可以在后台继续运行。
DSH 有没有保留 Skills 和文件工具、少一些复杂编排的预设？
想在 DSH 里按需压缩上下文并继续编码。
怎么启用一个带 Bash 沙箱和较长命令超时的编码工作流？
I want a lightweight coding setup in DSH with file editing and shell tools.
How can I keep long-running coding commands working in the background?
dsh-awesome-agent-preset 的功能「精简编码预设」：它提供 awesome-agent 预设，组合文件、Shell、Skills、后台任务和提问工具。安装后从 DSH 预设列表选择即可开始编码。
dsh-awesome-agent-preset 的功能「文件与项目搜索」：预设启用文件读取、图片读取、写入和编辑，并提供目录 glob 与 grep 搜索；配置限制结果数量和单行预览长度，便于在项目中查找和修改内容。
dsh-awesome-agent-preset 的功能「后台命令与上下文压缩」：Bash 工具启用后台任务并允许超时任务转入后台；compaction 组合提供手动触发的 /compact 命令及压缩阈值配置。
dsh-awesome-agent-preset 的功能「Bash 沙箱超时设置」：配置启用 bash-sandbox，设置 120 秒默认超时、600 秒最大超时和 3 秒宽限时间；同时禁用 PowerShell 工具与沙箱。

Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-awesome-agent-preset README · Highlights：- **Lean & Responsive**: Removes heavy orchestration layers (no file delivery tool (`present`), goals, complex plan modes, sub-agents, or TODO trackers). Focuses purely on fast, direct coding cycles.
- **Essential Tooling**: Retains core tools needed for day-to-day software development:
  - File reading, editing, and fast directory scanning (`fs`, `fs-search`)
  - Full-featured Bash execution (`tool-bash`)
  - Background asynchronous task management (`tool-jobs`)
  - External skill packs support (`skill-filesystem`, `tool-skill`)
  - On-demand context compaction & memory protection (`compaction`, `/compact`)
- **Tuned FS & Search Efficiency (Aligned with AGENTS.md)**:
  - `tool-fs-search`: caps `glob` results to ≤ 50 entries and `grep` matches to ≤ 50 (preview ≤ 500 bytes/line), preventing context flooding and utilizing spill files when exceeded.
  - `tool-fs`: `readLimit: 800` (max 600 chars/line, max 120KB), ensuring cohesive code units are read in full while preventing massive monolithic files from blowing up token windows.
- **Resilient Bash & Long-running Job Execution**:
  - `tool-bash`: enables background job support and `promoteO

dsh-awesome-agent-preset README · Installation：Run in your DeepSeek Harness environment:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-awesome-agent-preset

dsh-awesome-agent-preset README · or via GitHub repository：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-awesome-agent-preset
```

Or clone locally and link into your DSH profile:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Jaylor-Wang/dsh-awesome-agent-preset.git
```

dsh-awesome-agent-preset README · Usage：1. Restart or launch DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`).
2. In the preset dropdown list above the prompt input bar, select **`awesome-agent`**.
3. Start coding!
